## Getting Help

Use the repository's **Support / Question** issue form for usage questions.
Include the interface you used, package version, input values or a minimal CSV,
what you expected, and relevant output or screenshots.

Use the **Bug Report** form when the documented workflow produces an incorrect
or broken result. Security vulnerabilities must follow
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) and must not be filed publicly.

## Troubleshooting

- [Troubleshooting guide](../docs/reference/troubleshooting.md)
- [Known pitfalls](../docs/reference/known-pitfalls.md)
- [Engineering verification checklist](../docs/legal/verification-checklist.md)

Support can explain software behavior and documented scope. It cannot provide
project-specific structural-engineering approval.
